groupingNotes: Editorial muscle parents aggregate the three named pectoralis major/trapezius portions; no IS-A edge is promoted to PART-OF.
PART-OF names pectoralis major FMA13373/FMA13374 but includes only sternocostal and abdominal portions. Its omission of the clavicular portion is preserved as export incompleteness.
Clavicular pectoralis is labelled part but classified under head of muscle organ. Both classifications are preserved.
Ascending and descending trapezius are under organ zone FMA55268, outside the previous 403-element union. The transverse portion is under zone of muscle organ.
The four selected erector subdivisions do not represent the complete erector spinae group. No synthetic complete-group geometry is created.
Back is an editorial study region. Teres major belongs to the scapulohumeral transition, not to intrinsic spinal musculature.
No source OBJ header, geometry, vertex count, triangle count or anatomical fit is claimed validated by this metadata audit.
